author: GameTrailers
description:
Get another look at King in the Mountain, an upcoming strategic resource management incremental mining game about an exiled king rebuilding his fallen kingdom one expedition at a time. King in the Mountain will be available on PC. A demo is out now on Steam.

A forgotten mountain holds the gold, gems, and ancient artifacts needed to restore your kingdom. Getting them home starts with a handful of dwarves, a carefully chosen route, and a torch that will only burn for so long.
title: King in the Mountain - Official Demo Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Reveal Teaser Trailer for Slam Tank, a hack-and-slash action beat 'em up developed by Next Stage Inc. Players will embody a single tank, ready to swing and slam straight into the opposition. Take on the AI machine army in Slam Tank, coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Slam Tank - Official Reveal Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Nine the Phantom Update Launch Trailer for BlazBlue Entropy Effect X, a 2D action-adventure roguelike game developed by 91Act. author: GameTrailers
description: Luma Island is coming to PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X/S. It is already available on PC. Set on a sprawling, mysterious island, the game blends cozy homesteading, crafting, and farming with daring exploration through ancient temples, treacherous caverns, and puzzle-filled ruins.
title: Luma Island - Official Console Announcement Trailer

The Craaghelm Expansion for Thronefall is launching on November 11 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).

author: GameTrailers
description:
Meet the Tarbosaurus and see gameplay of this fearsome cousin of the Tyrannosaurus rex in the latest Jurassic World Evolution 3: Prehistoric East trailer for the upcoming expansion for the dinosaur park management sim game. The Tarbosaurus will require good security measures to keep your park safe. Jurassic World Evolution 3 is available now on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X|S. The Jurassic World Evolution 3: Prehistoric East expansion will be available on September 29, 2026.

In Jurassic World Evolution 3, build your own Jurassic World. Nurture generations of dinosaurs with the series debut of juveniles, create and manage sprawling prehistoric parks around the globe, and let your imagination roar with powerful new creative options.
